newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields rise on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills edged up by 0.01 point at the daily auctions on Thursday, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.50 and 3.83 percent, respectively, up from 0.49 and 3.82 percent on Wednesday and from 0.46 and 3.77 percent at Tuesday's auctions.

Bids were received for a total of 50.838 billion lev worth of T-bills as the two issues were oversubscribed but the ministry accepted bids only up to the limit of its total offer of 36 billion levs worth.
The issues were offered with par values of eight billion levs and 28 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 28,000 million levs
Bids received 11,510.1 million levs 39,328 million levs
Avg price of bids 99.49 pct 96.30 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 28,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 0.50 pct 3.83 pct
